landing.title: Start with a React foundation you can understand and trust.
landing.description: A documented Vite workspace with typed configuration, routing, state management, testing, quality gates, and the official Ant Design theme gallery already connected.
landing.typedDescription: Strict TypeScript, typed environment variables, aliases, router definitions, and state actions.
landing.qualityDescription: Formatting, linting, tests, coverage, production builds, and commit checks are part of the workflow.
landing.uiDescription: Ant Design components, official homepage presets, responsive layouts, and Ant Design Charts.
landing.footer: Documented incrementally for teams that want to know how their foundation works.
